title: BGN with a HUMP-SHAPED exposure across a mild visible level ladder: five types, cash-flow level [0.85, 0.925, 1.0, 1.075, 1.15], loadings [-0.14, 0.0, 0.14, 0.0, -0.14], exact compensation, price 2.5
question: With the b channel made larger than the level channel, is the premium hump-shaped in size (as KP14's is in b) and does DKKM take the room?
notes:
WHY (2026-10-30). bvyvee (level 0.6..1.4, b V-shaped at +-0.07) failed because the level itself moves the premium monotonically by about 1.15 %/mo across the ladder while +-0.07 in b moves it by 0.8. Measured on bvychsx2 / bvychsx3, b = +-0.14 / +-0.21 moves the premium by 1.8 / 2.4 %/mo; a level ladder of 0.85..1.15 should tilt it by about 0.45 %/mo. The hump in b across the level order is then a hump in size.

DESIGN. type_level as in bvyvee; bv_comp 1 so value at y = 0 does not reveal b and size tracks the level; b arranged -, 0, +, 0, - across it.
